retrievalProfile.description: A centered outdoor portrait of a seated figure on a brick path, featuring a mix of clean sans-serif and heavy psychedelic display typography in the upper right corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man with a beard and sunglasses sitting cross-legged on a weathered brick path, flanked by dense green foliage, with a two-tiered typographic lockup in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a diagonal brick path
Greenery framing the right side of the composition
Typography anchored to the top right corner
Warm earth tones in clothing contrasting with cool green foliage
coreInvariants: Cross-legged seated pose on a textured ground
Natural outdoor lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, medium-full shot, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and red-tinted sunglasses.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face to the text in the upper right, then down the diagonal line of the brick path.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense foliage on the right and the brick path on the left provide textured negative space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earth tones (ochre, tan, brown) in the subject's clothing and path.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep greens in the surrounding shrubbery.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red in the sunglasses and secondary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, natural saturation for the environment with high-saturation accents in the typography and accessories.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to organic, film-like color grading

letterConstructionRules: Top line: Clean, lowercase-heavy sans-serif with tight tracking
Bottom line: Thick, blocky, psychedelic-influenced letterforms with tight kerning and overlapping strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The display text features heavy, rounded terminals and compressed counters typical of 1970s bubble-style lettering.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Clean modernism paired with expressive, heavy retro-display.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider line between text blocks

preserve: The heavy, red, blocky display style

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, lowercase sans-serif top text.
Captures the heavy, rounded, psychedelic feel of the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man with a 70s hairstyle and red sunglasses sitting cross-legged on a diagonal brick path with green bushes on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of lowercase white sans-serif text in the top right, followed by a horizontal line and two lines of heavy, red, psychedelic block lettering.

verificationChecks: Is the text in the upper right corner?
Does the display text have a heavy, 70s-style weight?
Is the color palette dominated by earth tones and green?

mustAchieve: Natural, non-posed feel to the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Check for correct diagonal orientation of the path
Ensure the red text is legible against the green background
Verify the lowercase treatment of the top text
Confirm the subject's pose is relaxed and centered
recipe.reuseFormula: Seated portrait on textured ground + diagonal composition + upper-right heavy retro typography.
